subject: MdeModulePkg: : revert EndofDxeEvent TPLs to TPL_NOTIFY for FPDT
reasons: Simple, uniform substitution of TPL_CALLBACK with TPL_NOTIFY at two CreateEventEx call sites in two separate files
This is a revert of commit aa02571f36 which itself changed TPL_NOTIFY to TPL_CALLBACK in the same two locations — both the original commit and this revert are Coccinelle-expressible
Pattern is well-defined: within gBS->CreateEventEx(..., TPL_CALLBACK, ..., &gEfiEndOfDxeEventGroupGuid, ...) replace TPL_CALLBACK with TPL_NOTIFY
Adjacent commit aa02571f36 (offset -1 neighbor) performs the exact inverse transformation, confirming this is a repeating structural pattern that Coccinelle can express bidirectionally
candidate_pattern:
@@
expression callback;
expression ctx;
expression event;
@@
gBS->CreateEventEx(
   EVT_NOTIFY_SIGNAL,
-  TPL_CALLBACK,
+  TPL_NOTIFY,
   callback,
   ctx,
   &gEfiEndOfDxeEventGroupGuid,
   event
)
